title: GEMglClearAccum
description: specify clear values for the accumulation buffer

messages.description: red value used to clear the accumulation buffer

body: [GEMglClearAccum] calls glClearAccum() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. See glClearAccum in the OpenGL reference.
